observations: Photo 0: Front view of a microwave with a black glass door, stainless steel trim, and a control panel on the right. The brand 'SAMSUNG' is visible at the bottom right of the control panel. The display shows '3:53'.

All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON Jiji UGO-CHUKS NIG. LTD.'
